hardware.client: RTX4090 host, WSL, 1 Gbps management network; no inference contribution

python_matched_profile.vision_capability: E320: enabled; A0: disabled for text-only native comparison

native_profile: Mia compiles a 2048-row prompt chunk and uses its native planner/allocator. Graphs, side kernels, L2 prefetch and Engram AIO enabled; see benchmarks/competitors.md.

sudoingx.status: Not measured: current EXL3 dense drafter tensor formats require an adapter. No different weight pack substituted.

weights.A0: identity copy of the existing EXL3 2.9 bpw deployment; not native full-precision weights
weights.E320: 320 of 384 routed experts, unchanged retained bytes/top-6; pruning changes the model function
weights.manifest_provenance: Frozen round-one tensor manifest hashes; every current same-weight arm mounts the identical model view and rank cache read-only. Whole weight tensors were not rehashed during speed measurements.

timing: decode=(completion_tokens-1)/(last_content_chunk-first_content_chunk); whole request=end-start; prefill=input_tokens/TTFT. Multi-token chunks can bias short decode rates. Raw records preserve all timings.
sanitization: Private endpoint addresses/home directories replaced only in metadata/errors; request bodies and model outputs retained. Headers and credentials excluded.
scope: Exploratory same-hardware sequential arms. Short prompts: 9 repetitions; cold prefix: 3; 128K continuation: 1. E320 early and return baselines bracket the candidate. No cross-day statistical or broad quality guarantee.
quality: SciCode 50 validation subproblems, 15 parents, fixed seeds/high thinking; CanItEdit 12 tasks twice; same frozen protocol as previous round. Not AA official scores.
